pretreatments.description: Organosolv pretreatment using sodium hydroxide (NaOH) as a catalyst for Napier grass, and sulfuric acid (H2SO4) as a catalyst for Napier silage, conducted in 150 mL high-pressure stainless-steel vessels at 190 °C for 60 min.
